meta.name: migrate-from-openclaw
meta.description: Migrate from OpenClaw to NanoClaw v2. Detects an existing OpenClaw installation, extracts identity, channel credentials, scheduled tasks, and other config, then guides interactive migration. Triggers on "migrate from openclaw", "openclaw migration", "import from openclaw".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 迁移 OpenClaw 的配置与任务到 NanoClaw v2
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想从 OpenClaw 换到 NanoClaw,又不想丢失现有配置。
copy.tagline_en: Migrate your OpenClaw setup to NanoClaw v2 while keeping your data.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are moving from OpenClaw to NanoClaw and want to keep your existing setup.

howto.what: 检测本机已有的 OpenClaw 安装，读取身份、频道凭据、定时任务等配置，再与你逐项讨论决定迁入 NanoClaw v2 的哪些部分及落点。所有改动先展示后应用，凭据只显示前后四位。
howto.when: 当你说“migrate from openclaw”“openclaw migration”或“import from openclaw”等触发词时，技能开始检测安装并引导分阶段迁移。

say.text: 帮我把 OpenClaw 迁移到 NanoClaw v2
say.note: 启动发现流程并列出可迁移内容。

say.text: 从 OpenClaw 导入我的身份和定时任务
say.note: 会先展示扫描结果再逐项确认。

say.text: 把我的 Telegram 群和记忆文件迁过去
say.note: 按你选择的共享或独立方式处理。

howto.what_en: Detects an existing OpenClaw installation, extracts identity, channel credentials, scheduled tasks and other config, then guides an interactive migration to NanoClaw v2. Proposed changes are shown before applying; credentials are masked and data is never copied silently.
howto.when_en: Triggers on phrases such as "migrate from openclaw", "openclaw migration", or "import from openclaw". Runs discovery and walks the user through each migration phase.

say_en.text: Help me migrate from OpenClaw to NanoClaw v2
say_en.note: Starts discovery and lists what can be migrated.

say_en.text: Import my identity and scheduled tasks from OpenClaw
say_en.note: Scans and confirms each item before applying.

say_en.text: Move my Telegram group and memory files over
say_en.note: Handles them according to your shared/separate choice.
